name: Colette Leclair
original_name: コレット・リクレール
source:
A girl who lost her parents and was being raised by foster parents, but one day she was abandoned and became an orphan. She was found by Nina when she had collapsed on the street and was on the brink of death, and she recognized him as a man at first sight. Since then, she starts working at the mansion to keep his secret.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170928093605/http://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ170429.html]DLsite[/url]]
